name: weather-aware-truck-routing
description: Repository tooling: git hooks and commands that run both apps.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.setup:backend: uv --directory backend sync && (test -f backend/.env || cp backend/.env.example backend/.env)
scripts.setup:frontend: npm --prefix frontend install && (test -f frontend/.env.local || cp frontend/.env.example frontend/.env.local)
scripts.check: npm run check:root && npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.format: npm run format:root && npm run format:backend && npm run format:frontend
scripts.stack:up: docker compose up --build --wait && echo 'Web app: http://localhost:3000   API: http://localhost:8000/api/v1/'
